description: Call this when a self-employed user or small-business owner asks how much to pay in quarterly estimated tax (IRS 1040-ES) or CRA instalments and when. Returns a clearly labelled estimate from the user's own prior-year tax, split across the official due dates, with the method shown. It never says what the user owes.

country.description: US for the United States, CA for Canada.

expected_net_profit.description: Expected net business profit for the year, in the country's currency.

prior_year_tax.description: Optional. Total income tax on last year's return. Needed for an amount.

tax_year.description: Optional. Defaults to the current year.

name: estimate_quarterly_tax
title: Estimate quarterly tax payments
